components.name: Button
components.contract: Trigger one explicit action; native button semantics; disabled and pending never double-submit.

components.name: IconButton
components.contract: Named compact action with minimum target area; icon alone is never its accessible name.

components.name: Link
components.contract: Navigate to an application-approved destination; preserve browser open-in-new-tab behavior.

components.name: Text
components.contract: Render trusted/plain text with locale and wrapping; no untrusted HTML interpolation.

components.name: Heading
components.contract: Preserve logical document hierarchy independent of visual size.

components.name: Badge
components.contract: Present a category/status with text as well as color.

components.name: Avatar
components.contract: Display optional identity image; fallback initials and privacy-safe alt policy.

components.name: Separator
components.contract: Express visual or semantic separation without polluting keyboard order.

components.name: Surface
components.contract: Provide consistent bounded chrome; never impose dashboard cards on every control.

components.name: Stack
components.contract: Arrange children in logical reading order with tokenized spacing.

components.name: Grid
components.contract: Arrange responsive regions without changing semantic/focus order.

components.name: SplitPane
components.contract: Resize adjacent regions by pointer and keyboard while respecting minimum task requirements.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.contract: Preserve native scrolling, focus visibility, zoom and platform affordances.

components.name: TextField
components.contract: Label, description, validation, autocomplete and IME-safe controlled/uncontrolled value.

components.name: TextArea
components.contract: Multiline editing preserves draft, selection and composition across unrelated updates.

components.name: NumberField
components.contract: Locale-aware editing separates display text from exact numeric value; do not silently round money.

components.name: Checkbox
components.contract: Native checked/indeterminate state; group ownership and submitted value are explicit.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.contract: One selected option; native semantics or APG-equivalent keyboard behavior.

components.name: Switch
components.contract: Binary setting with visible label; changing setting is not implicit business submission.

components.name: Select
components.contract: Bounded enumerated choice with native-first semantics; empty and unknown value are distinct.

components.name: Combobox
components.contract: Searchable choice with APG behavior; stale remote options cannot overwrite current input.

components.name: DateField
components.contract: Calendar date rather than timezone-shifted timestamp; typed entry and picker agree.

components.name: DateRange
components.contract: Explicit inclusive/exclusive boundaries, timezone/calendar policy and keyboard operation.

components.name: Slider
components.contract: Bounded quantity with keyboard and text alternative; steps and units are declared.

components.name: SearchField
components.contract: Explicit/debounced query policy; composition input is not submitted mid-IME.

components.name: FileInput
components.contract: Native file selection; host owns upload and validation; no file bytes enter agent by default.

components.name: FieldGroup
components.contract: Group related controls with legend, descriptions and coordinated validation.

components.name: Form
components.contract: Native submission semantics, draft validation, error summary and explicit host action; rerender never submits.

components.name: Tabs
components.contract: Named panels with stable selection; automatic activation only when latency permits.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.contract: Reversible context path; approved routes and current-location semantics.

components.name: Pagination
components.contract: Stable cursor/page scope; loaded rows are not misrepresented as global selection.

components.name: Menu
components.contract: Action menu with focus return and keyboard behavior; no layout-generated business actions.

components.name: TreeNav
components.contract: Hierarchical navigation with stable node identities, expansion and keyboard semantics.

components.name: Tooltip
components.contract: Supplemental nonessential information; works on focus, dismisses, not the sole label.

components.name: Popover
components.contract: Contextual nonmodal surface with explicit focus/dismiss behavior and viewport containment.

components.name: Dialog
components.contract: Native-first modal semantics, focus containment/return and escape policy.

components.name: Drawer
components.contract: Inline or modal detail according to an explicit mode; do not mix the two focus models.

components.name: Toast
components.contract: Bounded transient feedback; essential errors remain persistently available elsewhere.

components.name: Alert
components.contract: Persistent status/error with severity semantics and actionable recovery.

components.name: Progress
components.contract: Determinate or unknown progress honestly; no invented completion percentages.

components.name: Skeleton
components.contract: Stable reserved geometry with reduced motion and a named loading state.

components.name: EmptyState
components.contract: Distinguish no records, no matches, forbidden data, loading and failure.

components.name: Metric
components.contract: One validated value or aggregate with units, scope and unavailable state.

components.name: Delta
components.contract: Explicit compatible baseline; zero denominator and percentage-point versus relative change distinguished.

components.name: KeyValue
components.contract: Labeled facts with stable ordering, wrapping and semantic links.

components.name: Detail
components.contract: Selected entity facts including missing fields; record identity persists across views.

components.name: RecordList
components.contract: Scannable records with identity-based selection and reachable additional fields.

components.name: CardCollection
components.contract: Repeated compact records; preserve reading order, headings and bounded loading.

components.name: Table
components.contract: Native table first; separate interactive-grid mode; sorting, paging, selection, virtualization and precise values.

components.name: FilterBuilder
components.contract: Typed predicates, AND/OR/null handling, visible inherited scope and explicit query application.

components.name: SelectionSummary
components.contract: Disclose selected identities or server predicate scope; never imply unobserved global selection.

components.name: Trend
components.contract: Temporal metric series, declared grain, gaps and exact accessible summaries.

components.name: Bar
components.contract: Comparable quantitative categories; baseline and negative values correctly represented.

components.name: Area
components.contract: Temporal area/stack with compatible additive measures; reject misleading nonadditive stacking.

components.name: Scatter
components.contract: Two quantitative axes, declared units, stable point selection and noncausal interpretation.

components.name: Histogram
components.contract: Declared binning, count/density labeling and missing-population disclosure.

components.name: Heatmap
components.contract: Two dimensions and one measure; accessible exact cell values and readable color key.

components.name: Matrix
components.contract: Entity-feature comparison preserving row/column association and useful comparison at narrow width.

components.name: Relationship
components.contract: Declared edges/cardinality only; deterministic bounded layout with accessible adjacency view.

components.name: Tree
components.contract: Explicit hierarchy, cycle validation, stable expansion and equivalent text navigation.

components.name: Treemap
components.contract: Nonnegative additive hierarchy; area meaning and tiny-node access preserved.

components.name: Timeline
components.contract: Dated events/intervals with timezone semantics, explicit overlaps and chronological alternative.

components.name: CalendarGrid
components.contract: Calendar-aligned 2D values/events; locale week boundaries and noncolor exact values.

components.name: Explorer
components.contract: Filter plus collection plus selected detail using shared parameter/selection state.

components.name: Comparison
components.contract: A stable compare-set with compatible metrics and simultaneous comparison affordances.

components.name: Breakdown
components.contract: Group a declared metric and inspect contributing records; recompute ratios from sufficient statistics.

components.name: Investigation
components.contract: Trend, baseline, event timeline and detail; associations never imply causes.

components.name: SearchResults
components.contract: Query state, collection, scoped result count and details with stale-result protection.

components.name: RecordEditor
components.contract: Existing primitive form over a host-owned action with entity revision and explicit save/cancel.

components.name: FormFlow
components.contract: Task-based steps, draft persistence, validation and reversible navigation before commit.

components.name: QualityPanel
components.contract: Source, freshness, completeness, provenance and unsupported claims displayed honestly.
